method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, bottom-up proof-search reverse paraphrase, and exact formula, macro, token and identifier comparison; not independent or human review.
scope: Three worked propositional LK derivations, including a failed branch and backtracking, excluded-middle proof search using contraction, and three exercise sets totaling twenty-four sequents.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: To derive A and B entails A, write the desired end-sequent at the bottom, select left conjunction because conjunction is the antecedent's only connective, and choose the initial upper sequent A entails A rather than the generally underivable B entails A.
samples.checks: Desired/lower/upper sequent roles, the structural-versus-logical search heuristic, antecedent side, two candidate premises and final completed tree are all preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For not A or B entails A implies B, choose right implication first to defer branching; exchange on the antecedent exposes the disjunction, left disjunction creates two branches, and weakening/exchange plus left negation reduce both branches to initial sequents.
samples.checks: Main-operator scope excludes the nested negation at the first step. Every branch, rule application, formula order and initial sequent matches the source. OLSEQ-001 records the source's four right-exchange labels on antecedent swaps, which remain unchanged.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For not A or not B entails not(A and B), right negation first avoids branching. Trying left conjunction produces a branch ending A entails B that cannot reach an initial sequent, so backtrack and apply left disjunction before completing both branches with left conjunction and left negation. The conjunction and negation steps could be interchanged.
samples.checks: The failed branch is presented as failure rather than a derivation. Backtracking, A/B symmetry, branch completion and optional rule order are preserved. OLSEQ-002 records the two missing negations in the frozen narrative candidates; the correct surrounding proof trees are exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A naive backward right-disjunction step for excluded middle reaches neither initial sequent. Right contraction instead lets proof search retain a duplicate copy of A or not A; a second right-disjunction step exposes not A, after which right negation, exchange, disjunction and contraction complete the proof.
samples.checks: Bottom-to-top search direction, two-copies-to-one forward meaning, retained premise copy and full rule sequence remain explicit; all proof trees are unchanged.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The three problem sets request derivations of four, twelve and eight displayed sequents. The last eight all require right contraction.
samples.checks: All twenty-four formulas, punctuation, enumeration order and the final contraction requirement are identical to the frozen source.

source_observations: OLSEQ-001: four antecedent swaps are labeled right exchange in the frozen source; preserved and disclosed.
OLSEQ-002: two narrative candidate sequents omit the negation on B despite correct surrounding formulas; preserved and disclosed.
limitations: No independent linguistic review has been performed.
Exact structural parity deliberately retains the two documented upstream defects; a later reader-facing correction requires a visible source note and deterministic projection.
The exercises are prompts only; this unit does not supply or validate their solutions.
